checks.text: The page displays the heading "Document Vault" and the text "No documents yet" when the vault is empty.
Clicking the button "Export backup" when the vault is empty downloads a file named "document-vault-backup.json" containing the text `{"version":1,"documents":[]}`.
Using the FileDropZone to add a file named "invoice.pdf" with content "PDFDATA" creates a list item showing "invoice.pdf" and "1 KB"; the text "No documents yet" is removed.
Typing "inv" in the search field labelled "Search documents" highlights the list item for "invoice.pdf" and displays the text "1 match".
Clicking the button "Delete invoice.pdf" removes the list item for "invoice.pdf" and the page shows the text "No documents yet".

After adding a document named "report.txt", clicking the button "Export backup" downloads a file named "document-vault-backup.json" containing the text `{"version":1,"documents":[{"name":"report.txt","size":0,"content":""}]}`.
Clicking the button "Import backup" and selecting a file containing `{"version":1,"documents":[{"name":"scan.jpg","size":100,"content":"IMG"}]}` adds a list item showing "scan.jpg" and "100 B".
Clicking the button "View report.txt" opens a dialog with the heading "report.txt" and the body text "PDFDATA".
Reload keeps the document named "invoice.pdf" visible in the list with its size "1 KB".
